mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 6 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods where FEDFUNDS is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points and an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the previous 3 months signal a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp and PAYEMS increases > 100k in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional mechanism where a decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% during a recession signals a contraction in demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 1% during a recession.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% and an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% over the previous 3 months signal a tightening supply and monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 1% and FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.
